name: Club Meeting - Maddie Briscoe Sustainable Initiatives at Georgia State University

content.text:
Maddie earned her bachelor’s degree in Journalism from Georgia State University in May 2025. She joined the sustainability team as a social media and marketing intern in January 2024 before transitioning to our engagement coordinator after her graduation.
